lead.event: IDX extends Wijaya Karya’s trading suspension over delayed bond and sukuk payments
lead.headline: IDX extends WIKA trading suspension over six delayed bond and sukuk payments
lead.blurb: Wijaya Karya shares will remain suspended across all markets until further notice after the company postponed six payments due 18 November. They comprise interest on three bond series and profit-sharing payments on three sukuk series. The IDX said the delays indicate problems with the company's business continuity.

earnings_guidance.event: XL Axiata reports a wider Q3 core loss as Mirae maintains its Buy rating
earnings_guidance.headline: EXCL posts wider Q3 core loss of Rp666 billion as Mirae maintains Buy
earnings_guidance.blurb: XL Axiata raised capitalized capex guidance to about Rp24 trillion. Mirae maintained its Buy rating with a Rp4,300 target price, projecting losses to shrink in Q4-2026 and net profit to reach Rp2.4 trillion in 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Semen Indonesia reports a 363% increase in 9M2026 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: SMGR reports 363% increase in 9M2026 net profit to Rp531.84 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: SIG's revenue rose 9.3% year on year to Rp27.67 trillion on sales of 27.87 million tons, while EBITDA increased 8.4% to Rp3.56 trillion and net financial expenses fell 37.0%. Since June, its subsidiary Solusi Bangun Indonesia has exported more than 300,000 tons of special-type cement to the United States through a partnership with Taiheiyo Cement.

earnings_guidance.event: Ciputra Development reports lower 9M2026 profit and receives an analyst outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: CTRA reports 18% 9M profit decline as analyst cites support through 2027
earnings_guidance.blurb: Ciputra Development’s nine-month revenue fell 10.80% to Rp7.485 trillion, while Q3 pre-sales rose 55% year on year to Rp2.901 trillion. Mirae Asset analyst Nafan Aji Gusta recommends accumulate buy with a Rp540 target, citing VAT incentives, potential rate cuts and new projects, including one slated for 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: MSCI demotes Bumi Resources Minerals from its Global Standard index
market_structure_policy.headline: MSCI demotes BRMS to Small Cap index from 1 December
market_structure_policy.blurb: Bumi Resources Minerals shifts from Global Standard to Small Cap in MSCI’s November review, effective 1 December. Shares touched a one-year low of Rp282, while Q3 revenue rose 172.8% quarter-on-quarter to US$71.8 million and net profit was US$11 million.

deals_control.event: AKR Corporindo agrees to acquire Vivo Energy Indonesia and Nusantara Karya Oranye
deals_control.headline: AKRA agrees to acquire Vivo Energy Indonesia and Nusantara Karya Oranye for US$15.5 million
deals_control.blurb: AKR Corporindo's subsidiary APR plans to integrate 47 Vivo fuel stations across Jabodetabek and Bandung into the BP-AKR network. Under the conditional agreement, APR would own 90% of both companies and non-affiliated Petro Palma Persada the remaining 10%, subject to preliminary conditions.
